correctness.rationale: For every p,q,L,T>0 and integer n>=1, exact favorable/adverse Riccati flow maps compose to F(z)=(Az+B)/(Cz+D), C>0, D>0, with fixed-point polynomial Cz^2+uv(p^2+q^2)z/q-p(pu-qv). The unique positive fixed point exists iff tan(qT/n)<(p/q)tanh(pL/n). At equality positive iterates converge to the boundary; above it all finite initial states cross zero in finite time. Strict concavity of atan((p/q)tanh x) gives T_n strict monotonicity; the third-order Taylor coefficient proves the n^-2 penalty and O(n^-4) remainder. 802 supplementary checker assertions passed, including direct ODE integration; no finite numerical checks are used as a global proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is not just Riccati existence: the full threshold family T_n is strictly increasing for all integer n, its gap from the averaged survival limit is exactly inverse-square with specified coefficient, and all finite n exhibit a positive-mean finite-loss window. Two full-text marsh sources motivate accretion feedback and changing sea-level conditions but do not imply this comparison. General periodic Riccati theory overlaps qualitative mechanisms and remains an acknowledged historical-priority risk, especially inaccessible Shayman 1985; inspected sources contain no same all-n theorem.
residual_risks: Historical priority is provisional: the full 1985 periodic Riccati phase-portrait article was not accessible, and the 2004 switched-system article was evaluated only at abstract level.
The result is an exact theorem for a specified idealized quadratic forcing model and is not a theorem for the different linear-deposition marsh model of D'Alpaos et al.
A broad specialized theorem on the strictly monotone effect of square-wave frequency could exist outside the retrieved literature.

value.rationale: The exact T_n family quantifies a distinct ecological-model question: how alternating adverse/favorable exposure duration, at equal cumulative durations and rates, changes eventual loss of a positive viability margin. It proves a sharp mean-forcing false-security window for every finite alternation count, the universal benefit of subdividing forcing, and a dimensionally explicit O(n^-2) finite-frequency penalty. This supplies a meaningful mathematical benchmark not reducible to a single parameter substitution or a routine numerical exercise. Scope is explicitly an uncalibrated quadratic approximation with no switching costs or spatial/stochastic feedback.
